argv: SELECT CASE WHEN "file_id" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("file_id" AS TEXT)) END AS "file_id",CASE WHEN "type_idx" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("type_idx" AS TEXT)) END AS "type_idx",CASE WHEN "descriptor" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("descriptor" AS TEXT)) END AS "descriptor",CASE WHEN "java_name" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("java_name" AS TEXT)) END AS "java_name" FROM types AS t ORDER BY t.type_idx
